text: In 1986, little Adelaide wanders away from her parents on the Santa Cruz boardwalk and [meets her double in a funhouse hall of mirrors|images|mirrors and glass]. Thirty-three years later, she reluctantly returns to the same beach on holiday with her husband and children. That night the lights go out and [a family of four stands in the driveway, each of them one of the Wilsons|threat|impostors and doubles], led by Red, who speaks in a rasp and says they share one soul and have come to [cut themselves free|wants|revenge for a wrong].
